tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi smon lam bzhugs so/ /na mo mañju shrī ye/shes bya'i mkha' dbyings zab cing yangs pa la/ /blo gros dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i 'od za
'jam dpal dbyangs kyi smon lam bzhugs so/ /na mo mañju shrī ye/shes bya'i mkha' dbyings zab cing yangs pa la/ /blo gros dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i 'od za

tei:div.tei:p: )'jam dpal dbyangs kyi smon lam bzhugs so// na mo mañju shrī ye/ shes bya'i mkha' dbyings zab cing yangs pa la// blo gros dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i 'od zer gyis// skye dgu'i mi shes mun pa'i tshogs rnams kun// sel byed dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud// deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar// khyod min bdag la skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas// las kyi dbang gis rigs drug gar skyes kyang*// 'khor ba'i 'jigs las skyobs shig 'jam pa'i dbyangs// bdag ni tshe 'di'i 'du byed gtong ba'i tshe// brtse zhing byams pa'i gnyen bshes kun dang bral// rngams shing 'jigs pa gshin rjes zin pa'i tshe// gshin rje'i 'jigs las skyobs shig 'jam pa'i dbyangs// thog med dus nas las ngan bsags pa'i mthus// srid pa bar dor nyon mongs rlung shugs kyis// bzod dka' ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar 'khyer srid pas// nyon mongs rlung sgo chod cig 'jam pa'i dbyangs// bar do'i rnam shes nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe// mi khom brgyad po dag las rab 'das shing*// thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rigs dag tu// skye ba'i rten 'brel sgrigs shig 'jam pa'i dbyangs// skye ba phyi mar mtho ris yon tan mchog /bdun gyis mdzes pa'i dal 'byor lus thob nas// bstan pa tshul bzhin 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen dang*// mjal ba'i rten 'brel sgrigs shig 'jam pa'i dbyangs// thabs mkhas thugs rje ldan pa'i bshes gnyen des// legs par gsungs pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs// tshul bzhin rtogs nas gzhan la ston nus pa'i// rnam dpyod blo gros rtsol zhig 'jam pa'i dbyangs// tshe rabs kun tu gzhan don kho na'i phyir// ser sna med pas sbyin pa kun gtong zhing*// rnam g.yeng spangs pa'i bsam gtan sgom pa sogs// phar phyin drug ldan rtsol zhig 'jam pa'i dbyangs// 'khor ba'i tsha gdung sel ba'i bsil byed mchog

/gsungs rab gangs ri'i ngos la blta 'dod kyang*// rnam g.yeng le lo'i 'dam du bying lags pas// myur mgyogs thugs rjes zungs shig 'jam pa'i dbyangs// zab lam lta ba'i lam la rab zhugs nas// rnam grol thar pa'i gling du 'gro 'dod kyang*// skal dman bdag ni 'khor ba'i zhags pas bcings// 'khor ba'i zhen thag chod cig 'jam pa'i dbyangs// rang don nyer zhi kun+dha'i tshal spangs nas// rlabs chen rgyal ba'i pad tshal blta 'dod kyang*// bdag gi blo 'dod ma rig 'thug pos sgrib// ma rig 'thib po sol zhig 'jam pa'i dbyangs// mdor na bdag sogs skye ba thams cad du// gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs la brten byed cing*// 'gro la 'dod dgu ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// yid bzhin nor bur gyur cig 'jam pa'i dbyangs// 'jam dbyangs khyod la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// tshogs gnyis rnam par dag pa'i gru chen gyis// 'gro rnams srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba la// bdag kyang khyod bzhin gyur cig 'jam pa'i dbyangs// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// phyi ma byang chub ma thob bar// rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis ni// bdag gi bla ma mdzad du gsol// gang tshe blta bar 'dod pa'am// cung zad 'dri bar 'dod na yang*// mgon po 'jam dbyangs khyod nyid ni// gegs med par yang mthong bar shog /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i// sems can kun don bsgrub bya'i phyir// ji ltar 'jam dbyangs spyod mdzad pa// bdag sogs spyod pa'ang de 'drar shog /bdag kyang 'jam dbyangs bka' drin gyis// sa rab dga' ba thob bar du// rtag tu tshe rabs dran pa dang*// rab tu byung ba thob par shog /brtse ldan khyod kyi mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa rab gsal nas// bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung lugs rtogs pa yi// blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba stsal du gsol// ye shes bla ma 'od kyi sku// de bzhin smon lam blo gros dang*// dbang po zhi dang 'jam dbyangs la// bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi// 'jam dbyangs mgon po bcom ldan 'das// stong nyid snying rje'i sgra yang sgrogs// tshe rabs ma lus thams cad du// bdag la dge ba'i las rnams mdzod// 'jam dbyangs smon lam rdzogs so/// /
